sidtracker64.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-14). SidTracker64 = modern iOS/iPad tracker by Daniel Larsson (Pernod), 2015 (last app update v1.0.5 Oct 2019). 259 HVSC SIDs, all PSID v2, 86% 8580+PAL. Closed-source app -> TARGET = the 6502 player + song data in the .SID EXPORT (not the .s64 authoring format). NO public source/spec; structure recovered from byte-stable HVSC inspection. PLAYER: init=load_addr (3-byte JMP trampoline), play=load_addr+$0003; player code 1930-2258 bytes across ~14 size-variants = APP VERSIONS (version detectable by code size); work area ~$6A bytes after code, then static tables; relocation (user load addr) added v1.0.5 - same code relocated. SMC per-song slots: $105F tempo, $107D orderlist-len, $101D filter mode, $101F/$1D filter routing. WRITE MODEL per play(): voice-writer x3 (X=0,7,14)->$D400-06; $D415/16 filter; $D417 routing; $D418=$0F|vol; tempo counter->step advance; per-voice duration countdown. Sidid sig 29 FE 9D 04 D4 = AND #$FE gate-clear hard-restart; 18 69 = glide ADC #$44/page-advance/note-step. PATTERN: $00-7F duration ticks, $80-FF note+instrument (2-3B), 128-byte page boundary w/ loop marker; orderlist 8 parallel lo/hi tables. FEATURES: 32 instruments (ADSR+wavetable+pulse+filter tables+vibrato+PWM sweep), 8 waveforms, sync/ring/hard-restart, arp=wavetable hi-freq mode; patterns 3 voices + 1 FX TRACK (per-step vol/filter/BPM); per-step glide/sustain/vibrato/tie. **TIMING: BPM-based, player ALWAYS sets CIA Timer A even when PSID speed=VBI; 47% carry CIA flag but CIA used internally in all -> plan --writelog-per-irq verdict family-wide (BPM != 50Hz).** Migration first step: disassemble canonical $1000 export for work-area/freq-table/instrument-block/wavetable encodings + the FX-track stream. TFX editor by Lada 'Ray' Lostak / Unreal (CZECH not Polish; UI by PseudoGrafx; later fixes/docs Jaymz Julian), 1995-2005. 269 HVSC SIDs, all PSID v2. KEY: TFX DESCENDS FROM DMC (Ray confirmed; 1996 DMC->TFX converter) -> leverage pipelines/dmc/ (already OK). LAYOUT ($1000 base, v2.x): 9-byte 3x JMP (init $10FA/play $1003/SFX $1914), version+title string $1009-37, freq lo $103A hi $109A (96B each), 8-byte subtune descriptors ~$1BCF, patterns follow; 8KB image $1000-2FFF. WRITE MODEL per voice: SR->AD->ctrl->PWhi->PWlo->freqhi->freqlo then $D418/$D416/$D417. PATTERN bytes: $00-5F note, $60-7F sec-speed, $80-BF duration, $C0-CF ADSR, $D0-ED instr/event, $EE vib, $EF glide, $F1-FF global fx. FEATURES (manual): sector seq <=80 sectors/5 subsongs; 8-byte instruments <=32; wave(2B: NRM/SHI/SHL/RHI/RHL/HRD), pulse(SAC 16-bit v2.99, SPL split v2.97), filter(all 11 bits v2.98+) tables; 6 table vars; multispeed 1-12x/72x-per-ch + $1003/$1006 split; ~20 sector effects (GLIDE/SLIDE/RLEN hard-restart-len/CTRL/FADE...). SIDID single sig all versions. Version split: V1.x (play=$1100, freq table @ $1000, DIFFERENT map - Group B/E2, ~36 SIDs) vs V2.x (play=$1003, manual layout). v2.94 anomaly: 32-entry lo-table + 36B dispatch block. CIA multispeed subset (Timer-A + frame-skip DEC) -> --writelog-per-irq. Migration first step: disassemble canonical $1000 v2.x tune to bind Player.ass/hyperPacker.c offsets; then map v1.x layout (no v1.x manual exists). Cleared to start disassembly.
